register_transformer_metadata: register transformer metadata for CogVideoX, CogView4, Flux, and Wan2.1 models in the context parallel registry
create_CogVideoX_transformer_plan: create a context parallel plan for CogVideoXTransformer3DModel with rotary embedding and transformer block inputs
create_Flux_transformer_plan: create a context parallel plan for FluxTransformer2DModel with hidden states, encoder hidden states, and image/text IDs
create_Wan2_1_transformer_plan: create a context parallel plan for WanTransformer3DModel with rope, encoder hidden states, and hidden states inputs
review_TransformerRegistry: review the TransformerRegistry class that registers and retrieves transformer metadata by model class
